title: Pushforward along a closed immersion
statement:
Let $i:Z\to X$ be a
closed immersion of
schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. The functor $i_*:\Ab(Z_{\Et})\to\Ab(X_{\Et})$ of
[def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is fully faithful, $i^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] is a
left inverse, and the essential image consists of those abelian sheaves $F$
on $X_{\Et}$ whose support is contained in $Z$, that is, with $F_{\bar x}=0$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] for every geometric point $\bar x$ of $X$ [def-weil-geometric-point] lying over a point of $X\setminus Z$. (For $X$ of finite type over a field this is the condition $\kunsupp F\subseteq Z$ of [def-kun-support].)

proof.text: Use the Full and Faithful instances of prop-openclosed-lowerstar-fully-faithful. Its invertible adjunction counit gives the natural isomorphism i_* followed by i^{-1} to the identity. Let j:U→X be the inclusion of the open complement of the closed image of i.

Support in the closed image is equivalent to j^{-1}F=0. For the forward implication, test j^{-1}F at the algebraic-closure geometric points of U, identify these stalks with the stalks of F at the composed geometric points using lemma-openclosed-stalk-upperstar, and apply lemma-weil-pbc-geometric-stalk-conservative (its jointly conservative family also detects zero objects). For the reverse implication, a geometric point of X outside the closed image factors through U. Its stalk is a stalk of j^{-1}F, hence zero, contradicting membership in def-kun-support. All geometric points and coefficient universes are unchanged; the uliftSheafFiberIso transports the stalk zero condition to the conservative universe-lifted family.

By lemma-openclosed-vanishing-lowerstar, j^{-1}i_*G is zero since the ranges are disjoint. Restriction preserves isomorphisms, so every object of the essential image has zero restriction and hence support in the closed image.

Conversely, assume support in the closed image, so j^{-1}F=0, and consider the adjunction unit η:F→i_*i^{-1}F. Its restriction to U is a map between zero objects, hence an isomorphism, by the preceding vanishing. Its restriction by i^{-1} is invertible: the left triangle identity makes it inverse to the invertible counit supplied by prop-openclosed-lowerstar-fully-faithful. The proved library theorem isIso_of_isIso_upperStar_map applies geometric-stalk conservativity to these two restrictions: each field-valued point factors through U or Z, and inverse-image stalks identify the corresponding stalk map with the restricted one. Thus η is an isomorphism. Its inverse witnesses membership in the essential image, with preimage i^{-1}F.
